activities.summary: Sourced from CMA Lebanon register and libank.com.lb. Genuine family-office/HNW/institutional fit; acquired Optimum Invest S.A.L. 100% in 2020 (separate CRM record). No current named leader found - needs enrichment pass.

Website contact sweep: read https://libank.com.lb/en/Home, https://libank.com.lb/en/Contact-us, https://libank.com.lb/en/Corporate-Governance&group=People, https://libank.com.lb/en/Corporate-Governance&group=Risk-Management. Applied email info@libank.com.lb. Every address here was printed on the firm's own site and transcribed, never constructed — challenge any of it against the page it came from.

description: Boutique Lebanese investment bank founded 2012 by senior bankers and strategic investors, USD 40m capital, regulated by BDL. Offers investment banking (capital transactions, M&A advisory, debt-equity structuring), private banking for HNWI/family-office/institutional clients, and asset management with international reach (Beirut and UK teams). Acquired 100% of Optimum Invest S.A.L. in 2020 (see separate record). Listed on CMA Lebanon's approved-institutions register.

fit.reasoning: Fit: priority segment investment bank serving family offices/HNWI/institutional clients (20) + Lebanon (15) + multi-asset (investment banking, private banking, asset management) (10) + manages third-party capital including via the Optimum Invest acquisition (10) + BDL/CMA regulated (5) = 60/60. Timing: sector-wide pressure only (10/25); as with Cedrus, an investment-bank license may carry different resolution exposure than a deposit-taking commercial bank, but this is not confirmed - open question. Access: no named current leader found in this research = 0/15. Total mechanically ~70, held to 50 given the missing named contact and the open resolution-track question; a genuine fit on paper (small, growing, multi-asset, family-office-facing) that needs a leadership-name enrichment pass.

name: LIBANK (Levant Investment Bank)

next_action.what: Confirm which Law 23/2025 restructuring track this bank is on (survivor/recapitalising vs resolution/liquidation) before any outreach
